# Anil Balaji Steel

> Anil Balaji Steel Pvt. Ltd. is a steel manufacturer and distributor based in Howrah, West Bengal, India, operating since 1972. The company manufactures rolling shutter profiles and accessories, MS/GP/stainless steel pipes, PPGL roofing sheets, plain sheets, and slit/pencil coils, and offers cutting, slitting, and custom fabrication services (ABS Fabrica) across Eastern India (West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam, Tripura).

Key facts: founded 1972, headquartered at Jalan Industrial Complex, Domjur, NH6, Howrah, West Bengal 711411, India. 250+ dealers, roughly 1,00,000 MT annual manufacturing capacity across product lines. Brand names include ABS ShaktiShutter™ (rolling shutter profiles), ABS FlowPipe™ (pipes), ABS BlueShield™ (roofing sheets), ABS TotalShutter™ (shutter accessories), ABS EdgeCut™ (plain sheets), ABS CoreLine™ (slit/pencil coils), and ABS Fabrica (B2C custom fabrication: gates, grills, facades, landscape structures).

## Products

- [Products overview](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/products): Full catalog across all product lines.
- [Rolling Shutter Gates — ABS ShaktiShutter™](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/products/shutter): Flat, super flat, diamond, gear, and perforated profiles in GI, CR, and PPGL. 15,000 MT/year.
- [Shutter Accessories — ABS TotalShutter™](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/products/shutter-accessories): Clips, pulleys, gear boxes, shutter motors and full installation hardware. 20,000 MT/year.
- [Pipes — ABS FlowPipe™](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/products/pipes): Round, square, and RHS pipes in MS, GP, and stainless steel. 6,000 MT/year.
- [Roofing Sheets — ABS BlueShield™](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/products/sheet): PPGL roofing sheets for industrial and residential use. 6,000 MT/year.
- [Plain Sheets — ABS EdgeCut™](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/products/plain-sheets): GI, CR, HR, and PPGL sheets cut to length. 24,000 MT/year.
- [Slit & Pencil Coils — ABS CoreLine™](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/products/coils): Precision slit coil and pencil coil to tight tolerance. 30,000 MT/year.
- [Cutting & Grinding Wheels](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/products/abrasives): Abrasive wheels for cutting and finishing work.

- [Services overview](https://www.anilbalajisteel.com/services): Loading, cutting, slitting, and fabrication services.
